purpose: Final locked-test reporting. Epochs selected on validation before opening the test. No ranking or selection.
scope: Offline agreement on recorded expert trajectories. Native survival, action success and clears require native evaluation.

test_design.aggregation: Equal replay weights within supported metric, then equal seed weights.
test_design.uncertainty: Range and sample SD across matched training seeds are descriptive. Stage rows and decisions are correlated within a replay.

definitions.movement: Greedy exact direction against the four-tick training label.
definitions.immediate_events: Starts begin from native idle; turns begin moving and change to another moving direction at the first future tick.
definitions.bomb: Positive if any of four expert input ticks sets Bomb; predictions use the greedy Bomb head.
definitions.bomb_onset: First positive window following an observed contiguous negative window in the same stage.
definitions.counts: Null rates indicate zero denominator. Button labels and onset counts do not measure actual Bomb consumption.
